mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and a pleasant temperature of 78 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, with the Waning Gibbous moon still visible.

In city news, crews are currently working to repair a water main break near 212 Todd Street. Water service is temporarily shut off for nearby properties, and the city appreciates your patience as repairs move forward.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of trivia options at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market and live music options later in the week.

In our weekly look at police activity, on August 17, officers responded to a request from the Department of Corrections to locate a 21-year-old man, resulting in an arrest in the 500 block of Cross Country Road.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Turtle Dove. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to head over and enjoy a treat.
